Umrah.headline: Umrah, arranged with care.
Umrah.body: From the visa to a hotel a few steps from the Haram, one team handles every detail so you can give your attention to the journey itself.

inclusions.guidance: Guidance before and during your stay

Umrah.imageAlt: The Masjid al-Haram in Makkah at night
Umrah.message: Hello Al-Hashar, I would like to request an Umrah package. Please send me the options and prices.

page.intro: Al-Hashar has arranged Umrah from Muscat for families and groups since 1984. Tell us your dates and how many are travelling, and a consultant prepares a package around you.

one.title: Tell us your dates
one.text: Send the month you want to travel, the number of pilgrims and the hotel standard you prefer.

two.title: Receive your package
two.text: A consultant replies with flights, hotels near the Haram, transfers and the visa steps.

three.title: Confirm at any branch
three.text: Confirm with your consultant in person or by phone, and travel with everything arranged.

flights.title: Flights
flights.headline: Tickets on every major airline, booked by people who answer the phone.
flights.intro: Al-Hashar has issued tickets as an IATA accredited agency for decades. Domestic and international fares, group bookings, and changes handled by a consultant rather than a call centre.

points.one: Domestic and international fares on the major airlines
points.two: Group and corporate travel handled by a dedicated consultant
points.three: Date changes and reissues done for you

hotels.title: Hotels
hotels.headline: Stays in Oman and abroad at rates negotiated for you.
hotels.intro: From a night in Muscat to a fortnight overseas, consultants book hotels worldwide at agency rates and match the stay to how you travel.

points.two: Agency rates and room categories explained plainly
points.three: Transfers added when you need them

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.headline: International holidays built around your family, not a brochure.
holidays.intro: Flights, hotels, sightseeing and attraction tickets combined into one package by a consultant who knows the destination.

points.one: Flights, hotels and sightseeing in one package
points.two: Attraction tickets and transfers included where useful
points.three: Honest advice on seasons and budgets before you commit

visa.title: Visa Assistance
visa.headline: Applications, documents and follow-up for most destinations.
visa.intro: Consultants prepare the application, check the documents and follow the case through, including Oman tourist visas for visiting friends and family.

points.one: Tourist and visit visas for most destinations
points.two: Oman tourist visas for your guests

insurance.title: Travel Insurance
insurance.headline: Cover arranged before you fly.
insurance.intro: Medical, delay and baggage cover for single trips or a whole year, arranged with your ticket so nothing is forgotten.

cargo.title: Cargo
cargo.headline: Door-to-door freight and personal effects, by air and by sea.
cargo.intro: A dedicated cargo division moves personal effects, vehicles and commercial freight in and out of Oman.

points.three: A dedicated division on its own phone line
